name: LDS Hymn Collections
description: Five LDS hymn collections: Hymns (classic, 1985/2002, 341 hymns), Hymns for Home and Church (new 2024 pilot, 72 hymns), Children's Songbook (1989, 148 songs), Youth Music (albums 2019-2023), and Hymn Helps (study aids). Key authors include William W. Phelps, Eliza R. Snow, Parley P. Pratt, and John Nicholson (LDS originals); also major Protestant crossovers (Watts, Wesley, Adams). D&C 25:12 designates song of the heart as a prayer; this is the canonical warrant for congregational hymnody in the Restoration. Notable: ~20 hymns appear in both classic Hymns and Hymns for Home and Church, and several are direct scripture paraphrases (e.g., Psalm 100 → 'All People That on Earth Do Dwell'; Isaiah 6 → 'Holy, Holy, Holy'; D&C 121 → 'How Gentle God's Commands' by tradition).
